built_from: elsewhere: justETF section tabs that jump the page (the founder, 2026-11-06)
reason: A person keeps a sense of where things are; when the page moves without their doing, they lose their place and have to find it again.
negative_check: planted clean controls in browser mode (sp500 pc, study fund phone)
held-out benchmark noise, with and without
status: passed the planted test and the control check (2026-11-06); still to run on the held-out benchmark (noise and catch rate, with and without) before it enters a version

result.runs: runs/candidate-moving/without and runs/candidate-moving/with (identical but for behaviour); personas first-job-phone and careful-retiree-pc, repeat 2, reader effort medium, graders high

p15_caught_in_first_10.note: every p15 session in both arms received the plant as a moved: line (sp500: 42 px up after the years; keren: the year control moving 69 px), so the gap is the instruction, not delivery; one-sided Fisher p about 0.004

justetf_tabs.note: not a test of the instruction: one session per arm got HTTP 429 and saw no page; in the with arm none of the three loaded sessions clicked a section name, in the without arm two did, were told the page scrolled 3,389 and 1,230 px, and did not report it. Other justETF keys 0 of 4 in both; j-help (liked) complained of in 2 of 4 in both

false_alarms.rule: a finding about movement the session was never told of in a moved: line, or about something not on the screen

movement_findings.with: 10 in 8 sessions, every one matching a moved: line that session received
detail: S&P 500 pc, 4 of 4 sessions: part of the screen jumped sideways on the first change of an input (115 px; the real defect of issue #200)
study fund phone, 4 of 4 sessions: the fields reshuffle when switching to self-employed (288 px up; real on the live page)
study fund phone, 1: a link at the top scrolled the page 2,784 px by itself (an in-page jump, real)
study fund phone, 1: the page scrolled 140 px when the year slider was moved; possibly the tool: act.mjs focuses an ARIA slider with el.focus() and no preventScroll, which can scroll the page itself

cost_usd.justetf_flag_graders: not recorded by grade-flag.mjs; about 0.5 estimated (32 grader calls)

result.verdict: Keep as a candidate that generalises: with the instruction p15 is caught 6 of 8 against 0 of 8 without, and the clean controls gain no false alarms (their new movement findings are all real and grounded, among them issue #200, missed 0 of 4 without). The justETF tabs were not exercised in the with arm, so that part is unanswered. It enters a version only after the held-out benchmark shows no rise in noise and no fall in catch rate. Cost to watch: movement findings take a place among the first 10 (44 findings in both arms, so another finding gave way).
